reason: The hypothesis proposes rapid solidification (>10^3 K/s) as a single intervention to simultaneously enhance strength and ductility in eutectic HEAs, which is not reported in any passage. The passages focus on thermo-mechanical processing (rolling, annealing, cryo-rolling) or precipitation, not on controlling cooling rate during casting. The mechanism (Hall-Petch and TWIP) is generic, but the specific application to as-cast eutectic HEAs via rapid cooling is a new idea not suggested by the literature.
